question_text: During a police investigation, a suspect is subjected to severe physical pain to extract a confession. The suspect later files a complaint. Under RA 9745 (Anti-Torture Act), which of the following statements is most accurate?

options.text: Torture may be justified if it leads to the prevention of a serious crime.
The prohibition on torture applies only to law enforcement officers, not to military personnel.
Torture is absolutely prohibited, and any evidence obtained through torture is inadmissible in court.
The suspect must prove that the torture was ordered by a superior officer for the complaint to prosper.
